rows.label: qst650403_msg0001
rows.name: There are some Ignas over there.

rows.label: qst650403_msg0002
rows.name:
Looks like Nascion and the others
are with them too, mo.

rows.label: qst650403_msg0003
rows.name:
There are more Ignas
than I expected...

rows.label: qst650403_msg0004
rows.name:
Could they be acting
in an organized way?

rows.label: qst650403_msg0005
rows.name: There are Blades among them, mo.

rows.label: qst650403_msg0007
rows.name:
So an Igna with the aptitude must
have touched a Core Crystal.

rows.label: qst650403_msg0009
rows.name:
That means Nascion and the others
are in serious danger...

rows.label: qst650403_msg0010
rows.name: Quick... We have to save them...!

rows.label: qst650403_msg0013
rows.name:
That Igna gives pretty good
orders, mo.

rows.label: qst650403_msg0014
rows.name: This isn't the time to be impressed.

rows.label: qst650403_msg0016
rows.name:
Sorry. I stood out too much
and they got away...

rows.label: qst650403_msg0017
rows.name:
Hibana, first we need to deal
with these ones.
